description: Extended business, governance, and operational threat patterns not covered in the main threat catalog

governance_threats.threat: No Audit Trail for Data Modifications
governance_threats.detection_rule: Dataset lacks metadata about source, modification date, or version
governance_threats.impact: Cannot prove data integrity for compliance audits (SOX, GDPR Art 30, HIPAA). Fines range from $10K to $20M.
recommended_actions: Implement DataSoul audit logging for all transformations
Timestamp every modification with user/system attribution
Maintain before/after snapshots for regulatory evidence
Export audit trail as PDF attachment to cleaned datasets
governance_threats.business_narrative: This dataset has no modification audit trail. For regulated industries, this is a compliance risk. DataSoul automatically creates a complete audit trail documenting every transformation, who approved it, and why.

governance_threats.detection_rule: Most recent timestamp in dataset is >30 days old for operational data, >90 days for strategic data
governance_threats.impact: Decisions based on stale data. Market conditions, customer behavior, and competitive dynamics may have shifted.
recommended_actions: Verify data pipeline is operational
Add freshness indicator to all dashboards
Warn users before generating insights from stale data
Recommend minimum refresh cadence by data type

governance_threats.detection_rule: Column names match sensitive patterns: salary, ssn, social_security, password, credit_card, health_condition, religion, ethnicity, sexual_orientation, disability, political_affiliation
governance_threats.impact: Presence of sensitive attributes may violate data minimization principles (GDPR Art 5), create bias in ML models, or expose the organization to discrimination claims.
recommended_actions: Review if each sensitive column is necessary for the analysis purpose
Apply differential privacy or k-anonymity techniques
Check for proxy variables that could indirectly reveal sensitive attributes
Document the lawful basis for processing each sensitive field

operational_threats.detection_rule: Dataset has geographic identifiers (city, state, zipcode, country) but no standardized region mapping
operational_threats.impact: Geographic analysis requires consistent region definitions. Without mapping, 'New York' could be in either 'Northeast' or 'Mid-Atlantic' depending on the business's region definitions.
recommended_actions: Create standardized region mapping dictionary
Apply mapping to create 'region' column
Handle edge cases (US territories, international)
Validate against business's official region definitions

operational_threats.threat: Unreliable KPIs Due to Data Quality
operational_threats.detection_rule: KPI source columns have >5% missing values or >2% duplicates
operational_threats.impact: KPI dashboards showing inaccurate numbers. Executive decisions based on inflated/deflated metrics. Board reports with incorrect data.
recommended_actions: Add data quality confidence indicators next to each KPI
Calculate KPI range (min-max) accounting for data uncertainty
Halt KPI reporting until critical data quality issues are resolved
Create 'KPI reliability score' for each metric
operational_threats.business_narrative: ⚠️ KPI Reliability Warning: {kpi_count} key metrics are computed from columns with data quality issues. Revenue may be overstated by {inflation_range}. Customer count may be inflated by {dup_pct}%. All KPIs should be treated as estimates until data quality issues are resolved.

operational_threats.detection_rule: Datetime columns contain timestamps in multiple timezones or timezone is ambiguous
operational_threats.impact: Event ordering becomes incorrect. Duration calculations are wrong. Cross-regional analysis is unreliable.
recommended_actions: Standardize all timestamps to UTC
Store original timezone as separate column
Verify event ordering after timezone normalization
Flag any events that change sequence after normalization

operational_threats.detection_rule: Financial column contains values in multiple currencies (detected via symbols or magnitude differences)
operational_threats.impact: Summing INR and USD values produces meaningless totals. $100 + ₹100 = nonsense.
recommended_actions: Detect and tag currency for each record
Convert to base currency using historical exchange rates
Store original currency and conversion rate for auditability
Flag records where currency is ambiguous

data_drift_threats.detection_rule: Column statistics (mean, std, percentiles) differ significantly between time periods or data batches
data_drift_threats.impact: ML models trained on historical data may perform poorly on recent data. Business metrics may show false trends.
recommended_actions: Compare column distributions between first half and second half of dataset
Run Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for distributional differences
Retrain ML models if significant drift detected
Alert business users that recent data differs from historical patterns

data_drift_threats.detection_rule: Column names, types, or count don't match expected schema from previous data loads
data_drift_threats.impact: ETL pipelines break. Dashboard queries fail. Missing columns cause analysis gaps.
recommended_actions: Compare current schema against baseline/expected schema
Flag new, missing, or type-changed columns
Verify with data engineering team before processing
Update pipeline to handle schema changes gracefully
